title: Semantic Packet v2.0.0
description: Canonical packet identity and lifecycle. Single source of truth across Postgres, Qdrant, Redis, Neo4j.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Breaking changes increment major.

packetKey.description: Immutable cross-store identity. Primary join key across all systems.

sourceRef.description: Source reference (file path, function, etc). One-to-many with packets.

workspaceRevision.description: Workspace/corpus revision at packet creation time

domainClass.description: Canonical domain classification (NULL = unresolved). Updated ONLY via mutation authorization gate.

predictedDomain.description: Non-canonical prediction from classifier ledger (informational only)

ontologyIds.description: IDs of accepted ontology relations involving this packet

vectorVersions.description: Manifest versions for all available vectors

metadata.description: Extensible metadata. NOT part of canonical identity.
